reconciliation.limitation_note: A passing reconciliation check verifies arithmetic consistency between complete-case transition intervals and case spans. It does not independently prove that individual transition durations are correctly attributed, non-overlapping, or representative of active work.

findings.title: High Duration Concentration on Refund Review to Refund Approved
findings.explanation: Transition 'Refund Review' -> 'Refund Approved' accounts for 57.98% of cumulative complete-case cycle time across 120 executions (mean elapsed duration 74430.00s).
limitations: Elapsed transition duration reflects chronological time between milestone recordings and does not distinguish active work from waiting time without explicit start/end lifecycle timestamps.
Duration concentration indicates where elapsed time accumulates; it does not independently prove an operational bottleneck, constraint, defect, or inefficiency without domain context.

findings.title: Repeated Execution of Item Inspected
findings.explanation: Activity 'Item Inspected' recurred at distinct timestamps in 10 complete cases (8.33%), with 10 total repeated occurrences beyond initial execution.
limitations: Repeated activities indicate re-execution patterns, which may represent intended operational rework, iterative review, or standard multi-step procedures.
Prevalent recurrence is an observation of process behavior, not independent proof of operational waste or process failure.
Identical-timestamp duplicate records (0) are excluded from recurrence counts.
